heroCopy: Ephemeral encrypted conversations. No accounts. No message history.
joinTitle: Create or join a confidential room
joinCopy: Enter a new PIN to create a room, then share the exact PIN with the people you invite.
pinHelp: ASCII characters only, up to 255 characters. Your PIN never leaves this browser.
whyLead: ACMTN is a short-lived relay for conversations that should not become a permanent record.
featureOneCopy: Choose a nickname. No email, phone number, profile, or identity check is required.
featureTwoCopy: Messages are encrypted in your browser before transfer. The relay cannot read them.
featureThreeCopy: Encrypted messages live only in RAM for up to 15 seconds, then are discarded.
securityNote: Your privacy depends on keeping a strong, unique room PIN secret. Anyone with that PIN can join the room.
stepOneCopy: A new PIN creates a room; a shared PIN joins one. The PIN is never sent to the server.
stepTwoCopy: Your browser derives a room lookup hash and a separate message encryption key from the PIN.
stepThreeCopy: Nickname, message, UTC time, and message ID are encrypted together in your browser.
stepFourCopy: The service relays ciphertext from RAM for 15 seconds. Participants decrypt it locally; expired messages are gone.
invalidPin: Use 1–255 ASCII characters for the room PIN.
genericError: The room could not be prepared. Please try again.
roomGateCopy: Enter the PIN used to create or join this room. It is checked only in your browser.
wrongPin: This PIN does not match the room address.
nicknameHelp: Names are anonymous and visible only inside encrypted messages.
invalidNickname: Choose a nickname of up to 255 characters.
invalidMessage: Write a message of up to 4,000 characters.
sendError: The message could not be relayed. Please try again.
expiryNote: Messages are relayed as encrypted ciphertext and expire after 15 seconds.
notFoundCopy: The address is invalid, expired, or no longer available.
tooManyCopy: Too many requests were received. Wait a while, then try again.
